instruction: Use the right arm to place the blue stapler with smooth finish on the compact black hollow displaystand.

source.instruction: Use the right arm to place the blue stapler with smooth finish on the compact black hollow displaystand.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the RIGHT arm grasped the object, which was at x = +21 (right half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move the right gripper above the blue stapler at (22, -1.5, 94) and orient downwards.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-9, +17, -0) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (21, -2, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower the right gripper toward grasp height, down to z=87.5 cm.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -7) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +13 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (21, -2, 87) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower the gripper to z=77.5 cm around the stapler and close fingers to grasp.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -10) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +3 cm (vertical) from the object; closed the gripper (opening 0.24: holding the object)

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (21, -2, 78) opening 0.24; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift the stapler slightly to z=84 cm before transport.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+0, -0, +6) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +3 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (22, -2, 83) opening 0.26; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift further and move the stapler above the display stand to around (3, -10, 92).
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-18, -8, +8) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +3 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (3, -10, 92) opening 0.27; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower the stapler onto the stand to z=87 cm and open the gripper to release.
